title: Observational Equivalence in Coloured Linear Structural Models with Singleton Edge Classes
banked_reason: substrate-unbuildable: two verified Causalean studies, two local adapters, and fourteen further F3 rounds still leave three load-bearing paper-specific proofs for noncompact blocked-covariance BIC consistency, comparison-parameter elimination, and restricted rational-effect nonconstancy.
gap_reasons: Needs noncompact blocked-covariance BIC consistency and elimination of comparison parameters; concept/type/goal CLI searches, lean_local_search, Mathlib leansearch/loogle, and the relevant API sections found only compact-model finiteCovarianceModel_populationGap/HasCompactDiscrepancySublevel and joint-parameter rationalMatrixMap_imageIntersection_locus, which do not compose because blocked covariance images are noncompact and the joint locus does not produce a nonzero polynomial solely on C's parameter space.

Irreducible residual: proving unconditional Gaussian discrepancy compact sublevels plus relative closedness for every noncompact blocked covariance image, and eliminating the comparison parameter from the real joint algebraic locus to an exact nonzero zero-locus polynomial on the reference parameter space.
Global positive-definite nonconstancy does not directly provide formal nonconstancy of the effect map restricted through rawCovParam.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery passed at field tier and formalization proved the constructive bounded binary-star separator, the sharp finite dictionary, the complete blocked-equivalence theorem, and the exact Chickering covered-reversal gate. Two independently verified Causalean studies and two paper-local adapter builds supplied finite-model selection, polynomial zero-locus, Gaussian discrepancy, rational intersection, and derivative-locus infrastructure. Fourteen subsequent F3 rounds still could not close three paper-specific obligations: noncompact blocked-covariance BIC recovery, its downstream simultaneous inference theorem, and certificate vanishing via comparison-parameter elimination/restricted rational nonconstancy; retry only with new architecture for those cores.
tldr: Target-local equality constraints among structural coefficients encode causal communities, but permitting singleton communities restores observational ambiguity. Every discrepancy detected by the proved signature criterion is nevertheless exposed by a unit-noise covariance generated from at most two coefficient-one blocks at one target, with integer entries bounded by \(p\) and an exact determinant or cleared-regression value in \(\{-2,-1,1,2\}\). The resulting universal binary-star library has the exact size \(\sum_j[|\Pi^{E_0}_j|+\binom{|\Pi^{E_0}_j|}{2}]\), at most the sharp worst-case value \(\binom{p+1}{3}\). Covariance-model equality is equivalent to signature equality and to connectivity by legal singleton covered reversals, enabling exact component enumeration and a qualified fixed-\(p\) rung for generic global-BIC component recovery and simultaneous member-labelled total-effect inference.
gap: BoegeKubjasMisraSolus2026 proves identifiability only when every blocked edge-colour class is nonsingleton and leaves graphical equivalence open. Its rational constraints and the determinant machinery of SullivantTalaskaDraisma2010 and DrtonRobevaWeihs2020 do not provide a uniformly small observable witness when singleton blocks are admitted.
fill: The project derives the four-case binary-star router and logarithmic numerical-height guarantee, lifts Chickering's disagreement-decreasing sequence to the exact legal blocked move graph, enumerates the resulting component, and attaches pointwise generic selection and effect-set inference without claiming uniformity at model intersections.
